name.zh: 老車站 6 選：木造月台的時光
name.en: Six Old Stations with Wooden Platforms

description.zh: 從山城內灣到平溪菁桐，六座老車站還留著木造站房和手寫時刻表的味道，一站蓋一枚。
description.en: From hillside Neiwan to Jingtong on the Pingxi line, six stations that still keep their wooden halls and old-railway feel.

name.zh: 古蹟尋跡：荷蘭、清朝到日治
name.en: Heritage Trail: Dutch, Qing and Japanese Eras

description.zh: 荷蘭人的紅磚、清朝的廟宇、日治的街屋，六座古蹟串起四百年的島嶼故事。
description.en: Dutch brick, Qing temples and Japanese-era shophouses: six sites that tell four hundred years of the island's story.

name.zh: 府城散策：古堡、老車站與一碗豆花
name.en: A Walk Through Tainan: Forts, a Station and Tofu Pudding

description.zh: 走過荷蘭城堡和昭和車站，看完新圖書館與奇美，最後在安平吃一碗豆花收尾。
description.en: A Dutch fort, a Shōwa-era station, a new library and the Chimei Museum, finished with a bowl of tofu pudding in Anping.

name.zh: 北中南博物館：六種看世界的方式
name.en: Six Museums, Six Ways to See the World

description.zh: 從故宮的翠玉白菜到科博館的恐龍，北中南六座館，一趟看遍藝術、自然與海港。
description.en: From jade cabbage at the Palace Museum to dinosaurs in Taichung, six museums from north to south.

name.zh: 觀光工廠：威士忌、巧克力與漢餅
name.en: Factory Tours: Whisky, Chocolate and Pastry

description.zh: 聞一聞威士忌桶、捏一塊巧克力、畫一支蠟筆，六座觀光工廠都能動手做。
description.en: Smell whisky casks, shape chocolate, paint a crayon: six factories where you get to make something yourself.

name.zh: 島嶼閱讀：六座城市最安靜的角落
name.en: Island Reading: Six Quiet Libraries

description.zh: 森林裡的北投分館、綠美圖的玻璃書牆，六座圖書館是每座城市最安靜的角落。
description.en: Beitou's library in the trees, Taichung's glass book walls: six libraries that are each city's quietest corner.

name.zh: 夜市小吃：把臺灣吃過一遍
name.en: Night Markets: Eat Your Way Around Taiwan

description.zh: 一碗大腸麵線、一盤火雞肉飯、一顆包子，七站吃完，臺灣的小吃地圖就蓋滿了。
description.en: Intestine noodles, turkey rice, steamed buns: seven stops and your Taiwan snack map is complete.

name.zh: 植物園與森林：放慢腳步呼吸
name.en: Gardens and Forests to Slow Down In

description.zh: 城市裡的植物園到山裡的森林遊樂區，六個地方適合放慢腳步，聞著樹的味道走一段。
description.en: From city botanical gardens to mountain forest parks, six places to slow down and walk among the trees.

name.zh: 東京初訪：博物館、淺草寺與築地
name.en: First Time in Tokyo: Museums, Sensō-ji and Tsukiji

description.zh: 上野看國寶、淺草寺求籤、築地吃玉子燒，第一次來東京，從這六個地方開始。
description.en: National treasures in Ueno, a fortune at Sensō-ji and tamagoyaki in Tsukiji: six places to start your first Tokyo trip.

name.zh: 京都古都：千本鳥居到竹林小徑
name.en: Old Kyoto: Torii Gates to the Bamboo Grove

description.zh: 穿過千本鳥居、走進嵐山竹林、在錦市場邊走邊吃，京都要用腳慢慢認識。
description.en: Walk through a thousand torii, into the Arashiyama bamboo and down Nishiki Market: Kyoto is best taken slowly, on foot.

name.zh: 大阪一日：城堡、市場與自己的杯麵
name.en: A Day in Osaka: Castle, Market and Your Own Cup Noodles

description.zh: 登大阪城、在黑門市場吃海鮮，最後到池田畫一個只屬於自己的杯麵杯。
description.en: Climb Osaka Castle, eat seafood in Kuromon Market, then design your own cup noodles in Ikeda.

name.zh: 北海道：甜點、啤酒與薰衣草
name.en: Hokkaido: Sweets, Beer and Lavender

description.zh: 白色戀人的工廠、札幌啤酒的紅磚館、小樽老車站，夏天再到富良野看紫色花田。
description.en: The Shiroi Koibito factory, Sapporo's red-brick beer museum and Otaru's old station, with Furano's lavender in summer.

name.zh: 沖繩本島：首里城一路到美麗海
name.en: Okinawa Loop: Shuri Castle to Churaumi

description.zh: 從首里城和那霸市場出發，一路往北到萬座毛的斷崖和美麗海的鯨鯊。
description.en: From Shuri Castle and Naha's market up the coast to the cliffs of Manzamo and the whale sharks at Churaumi.

name.zh: 日本市場：邊走邊吃四座市場
name.en: Four Japanese Markets to Snack Through

description.zh: 東京、京都、大阪、那霸各一座市場，空著肚子去，邊走邊吃蓋滿四枚章。
description.en: One market each in Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka and Naha: come hungry and eat your way to four stamps.

name.zh: 澳門世遺：大三巴走到一顆蛋塔
name.en: Macao Heritage: From the Ruins to an Egg Tart

description.zh: 從大三巴的石階走過葡式碎石路和老炮台，一路到路環，最後咬一口剛出爐的蛋塔。
description.en: Up the steps of St Paul's, along Portuguese mosaic streets and old forts, ending with a warm egg tart in Coloane.

name.zh: 首爾宮殿與韓屋村
name.en: Seoul's Palaces and Hanok Lanes

description.zh: 在景福宮看守門將換崗，走進北村的韓屋巷弄，再到老首爾站看這座城的過去。
description.en: Watch the guard change at Gyeongbokgung, wander Bukchon's hanok lanes, then see old Seoul at the former station.

name.zh: 首爾：書牆、市場與南山夜景
name.en: Seoul: Book Walls, Markets and Namsan at Night

description.zh: 東大門的銀色曲面、星空圖書館的書牆、廣藏市場的綠豆煎餅，晚上再上南山看夜景。
description.en: Silver curves at DDP, the Starfield book walls, mung-bean pancakes at Gwangjang, then the night view from Namsan.

name.zh: 釜山：魚市場、甘川洞與海岸列車
name.en: Busan: Fish Market, Gamcheon and the Coastal Train

description.zh: 札嘎其的海鮮、甘川洞的彩色山城、太宗台的斷崖，最後到海邊的龍宮寺聽浪。
description.en: Seafood at Jagalchi, the colourful hills of Gamcheon, the cliffs of Taejongdae and a temple right on the waves.

name.zh: 濟州島：日出峰、茶園與海岬
name.en: Jeju: Sunrise Peak, Tea Fields and Sea Cliffs

description.zh: 清晨爬上城山日出峰，沿涉地可支的海岬散步，再到綠茶園和東門市場吃一輪。
description.en: Climb Seongsan for sunrise, walk the Seopjikoji headland, then green tea fields and Dongmun Market.

name.zh: 香港初訪：山頂纜車與廟街
name.en: First Time in Hong Kong: Peak Tram and Temple Street

description.zh: 西九的兩座新博物館、尖沙咀鐘樓，搭纜車上山頂看維港，晚上到廟街吃煲仔飯。
description.en: Two new museums in West Kowloon, the clock tower, the Peak Tram up to the harbour view and Temple Street at night.

name.zh: 香港老街、廟宇與天壇大佛
name.en: Hong Kong's Old Streets, Temples and the Big Buddha

description.zh: 文武廟的盤香、一杯絲襪奶茶、大埔的老火車站，再上大嶼山看天壇大佛。
description.en: Incense coils at Man Mo, a cup of silk-stocking milk tea, the old Tai Po station and the Big Buddha on Lantau.

name.zh: 雪梨港：歌劇院與岩石區
name.en: Sydney Harbour: The Opera House and The Rocks

description.zh: 從歌劇院的白色風帆走進岩石區老街，再到植物園、維多利亞女王大廈和新魚市場。
description.en: From the Opera House sails into The Rocks, then the botanic garden, the QVB and the new fish market.

name.zh: 墨爾本：巷弄、圖書館與市場
name.en: Melbourne: Laneways, Library and Market

description.zh: 從福林德斯街車站出發，鑽進咖啡巷弄，走到州立圖書館的圓頂閱覽室和女王市場。
description.en: Start at Flinders Street, duck through coffee laneways and end at the domed library and Queen Victoria Market.

name.zh: 昆士蘭：抱無尾熊、搭火車上山
name.en: Queensland: Koalas and a Train to Kuranda

description.zh: 在布里斯本抱無尾熊、喝 XXXX 啤酒，再到凱恩斯搭百年觀光火車上庫蘭達。
description.en: Meet koalas and taste XXXX in Brisbane, then ride the century-old railway up to Kuranda from Cairns.

name.zh: 紐西蘭北島：火山、哈比村與地熱
name.en: North Island: Volcanoes, Hobbiton and Hot Springs

description.zh: 奧克蘭的火山丘和魚市場，再到哈比村的圓門小屋和羅托魯瓦冒煙的地熱谷。
description.en: Auckland's volcanic cones and fish market, then Hobbiton's round doors and the steaming valley at Rotorua.

name.zh: 紐西蘭南島：纜車、漢堡與湖畔教堂
name.en: South Island: Gondola, Burgers and a Lakeside Church

description.zh: 基督城的老車站和植物園，皇后鎮搭纜車、吃一個大漢堡，再到蒂卡波看湖邊小教堂。
description.en: Christchurch's old station and gardens, a gondola and a big burger in Queenstown, then the lakeside church at Tekapo.

name.zh: 華沙：重建的老城與新的華沙
name.en: Warsaw: The Rebuilt Old Town and the New City

description.zh: 戰後一磚一瓦重建的老城，加上猶太人歷史博物館和屋頂花園，看華沙怎麼重新站起來。
description.en: An old town rebuilt brick by brick, a museum of Polish Jewish history and a rooftop garden: how Warsaw rose again.

name.zh: 克拉科夫：王城與地下鹽礦
name.en: Kraków: Royal City and the Salt Mine

description.zh: 中央廣場的號角聲、瓦維爾的王城，再下到維利奇卡鹽礦看鹽雕的教堂。
description.en: The bugle call over the main square, Wawel's royal hill and a chapel carved from salt deep in Wieliczka.

name.zh: 倫敦：博物館、倫敦塔與倫敦眼
name.en: London: Museums, the Tower and the Eye

description.zh: 大英博物館的羅塞塔石碑、倫敦塔的王冠，再搭倫敦眼、到邱園的溫室散步。
description.en: The Rosetta Stone, the Crown Jewels, a turn on the London Eye and a walk through the glasshouses at Kew.

name.zh: 倫敦：書店、市集與老車站
name.en: London: Bookshops, Markets and Stations

description.zh: 大英圖書館、Daunt Books 的綠色書架、波羅市場的小吃，在聖潘克拉斯的大鐘下結束。
description.en: The British Library, Daunt Books' green shelves and Borough Market, ending under the clock at St Pancras.

name.zh: 愛丁堡：城堡、威士忌與亞瑟王座
name.en: Edinburgh: Castle, Whisky and Arthur's Seat

description.zh: 從城堡沿皇家哩大道走下來，喝一杯蘇格蘭威士忌，最後爬上亞瑟王座看整座城。
description.en: Walk down the Royal Mile from the castle, taste Scotch on the way and climb Arthur's Seat for the whole city.

name.zh: 紐約經典：自由女神到中央公園
name.en: Classic New York: Liberty to Central Park

description.zh: 搭船看自由女神、登帝國大廈、穿過中央車站的大廳，再到中央公園和博物館。
description.en: Take the ferry to Liberty, go up the Empire State, cross Grand Central's concourse and finish in Central Park.

name.zh: 紐約：石獅、書店與市集
name.en: New York: Library Lions, Bookshops and Markets

description.zh: 跟公共圖書館的石獅子打招呼，逛 Strand 的十八英里書架，晚上到麥迪遜廣場花園。
description.en: Say hello to the library lions, browse Strand's eighteen miles of books and catch a game at the Garden.

name.zh: 舊金山：金門大橋與惡魔島
name.en: San Francisco: Golden Gate and Alcatraz

description.zh: 走上金門大橋、在渡輪大廈吃生蠔，搭船登惡魔島，最後在北灘喝一杯義式咖啡。
description.en: Walk the Golden Gate, eat oysters at the Ferry Building, take the boat to Alcatraz and end with espresso in North Beach.

name.zh: 洛杉磯：天文台、美術館與樂園
name.en: Los Angeles: Observatory, Art and Theme Parks

description.zh: 在格里菲斯天文台看好萊塢標誌，到蓋蒂中心看花園，再去迪士尼和環球影城。
description.en: See the Hollywood sign from Griffith Observatory, the gardens at the Getty, then Disneyland and Universal.

name.zh: 西雅圖：拋魚市場與太空針
name.en: Seattle: Flying Fish and the Space Needle

description.zh: 在派克市場看魚販把鮭魚拋過櫃台，再上太空針塔看雷尼爾山。
description.en: Watch fishmongers throw salmon at Pike Place, then ride up the Space Needle for Mount Rainier.

name.zh: 多倫多與尼加拉瀑布
name.en: Toronto and Niagara Falls

description.zh: 登上 CN 塔、逛聖勞倫斯市場和卡薩羅馬城堡，再到尼加拉站在馬蹄瀑布的水霧裡。
description.en: Up the CN Tower, through St. Lawrence Market and Casa Loma, then into the mist at Horseshoe Falls.

name.zh: 溫哥華：圖騰柱、市場與吊橋
name.en: Vancouver: Totems, Market and the Suspension Bridge

description.zh: 史丹利公園的圖騰柱、格蘭維爾島的市場，再走過卡皮拉諾高空吊橋。
description.en: Totem poles in Stanley Park, the market on Granville Island and the swaying Capilano Suspension Bridge.

name.zh: 魁北克與蒙特婁：法式老城
name.en: Québec and Montréal: The French Old Towns

description.zh: 蒙特婁聖母大教堂的藍色星空拱頂，魁北克舊城上的芳堤娜城堡，像走進一座法國小城。
description.en: The blue starry vault of Notre-Dame in Montréal and Château Frontenac above old Québec, a little piece of France.

name.zh: 開羅與吉薩：站到金字塔前
name.en: Cairo and Giza: Stand Before the Pyramids

description.zh: 站到吉薩金字塔前，看大埃及博物館的法老寶藏，逛開羅老市集，再到海邊的亞歷山大圖書館。
description.en: Stand before the Giza pyramids, see the pharaohs' treasures, wander old Cairo's bazaar and visit the library by the sea.

name.zh: 尼羅河神殿：路克索到阿布辛貝
name.en: Nile Temples: Luxor to Abu Simbel

description.zh: 卡納克的巨柱廳、帝王谷的彩繪墓室，一路往南到阿布辛貝的四尊巨像。
description.en: The great hall of columns at Karnak, painted tombs in the Valley of the Kings and the four colossi of Abu Simbel.

name.zh: 亞太名校：在校門口蓋一枚章
name.en: Great Campuses of Asia-Pacific

description.zh: 臺大的椰林大道、東大赤門、京大時計台，到港大、延世和雪梨、墨爾本，每所名校蓋一枚。
description.en: NTU's palm boulevard, UTokyo's Red Gate, Kyoto's clock tower and more: one stamp at each great campus.

name.zh: 奧斯陸：走上歌劇院屋頂
name.en: Oslo: Walk Up the Opera House Roof

description.zh: 走上歌劇院的白色斜屋頂，看孟克的《吶喊》和維格蘭雕塑，再到市集吃一輪。
description.en: Walk up the Opera House's sloping roof, see Munch's Scream and the Vigeland sculptures, then eat at the food hall.

name.zh: 挪威峽灣到北極圈
name.en: Norway: Fjords to the Arctic Circle

description.zh: 卑爾根的彩色木屋和魚市場，搭弗洛姆鐵道穿過峽灣，最後到北極圈的特羅姆瑟。
description.en: Bergen's coloured wharf houses and fish market, the Flåm Railway through the fjords and on to Arctic Tromsø.

name.zh: 斯德哥爾摩：沉船、舊城與肉桂捲
name.en: Stockholm: A Warship, the Old Town and Cinnamon Buns

description.zh: 舊城廣場的彩色房子、瓦薩沉船、一杯咖啡配肉桂捲，再到哥德堡坐雲霄飛車。
description.en: Coloured houses in Gamla stan, the Vasa warship, coffee and a cinnamon bun, then rollercoasters in Gothenburg.

name.zh: 赫爾辛基：教堂、圖書館與海上要塞
name.en: Helsinki: Churches, a Library and a Sea Fortress

description.zh: 白色大教堂、岩石教堂、Oodi 圖書館的三樓，搭渡輪到芬蘭堡，最後在海邊小木屋喝咖啡。
description.en: The white cathedral, the rock church, Oodi's top floor, the ferry to Suomenlinna and coffee in a seaside cabin.

name.zh: 拉普蘭：跨過北極圈找聖誕老人
name.en: Lapland: Cross the Arctic Circle to Meet Santa

description.zh: 在羅瓦涅米跨過北極圈的線，跟聖誕老人握個手，再到北極博物館認識極地。
description.en: Step over the Arctic Circle line in Rovaniemi, shake hands with Santa and learn about the north at Arktikum.

name.zh: 大稻埕：茶行、廟埕與百年西餐廳
name.en: Dadaocheng: Tea Houses, Temples and a 1934 Restaurant

description.zh: 從河邊碼頭走進迪化街，老茶行飄著焙茶香，廟埕吃一碗米粉湯，再到 1934 年開業的波麗路。
description.en: From the riverside wharf into Dihua Street, past roasting tea houses and temple-front snacks to Bolero, open since 1934.

name.zh: 北投：溫泉霧裡的一個下午
name.en: Beitou: An Afternoon in the Hot-Spring Steam

description.zh: 出了新北投站就聞得到硫磺味，沿溫泉溪走過老浴場、森林裡的圖書館，終點是冒著白煙的地熱谷。
description.en: The sulphur hits you at Xinbeitou Station: follow the stream past an old bathhouse and a library in the trees to steaming Thermal Valley.

name.zh: 艋舺與西門：臺北最老的街區
name.en: Bangka and Ximen: Taipei's Oldest Streets

description.zh: 龍山寺的香火、剝皮寮的紅磚街、八角形的紅樓，中間停下來吃一碗站著吃的麵線。
description.en: Incense at Lungshan Temple, Bopiliao's red-brick lane and the octagonal Red House, with noodles eaten standing up.

name.zh: 從眷村走到 101
name.en: From a Military Village to Taipei 101

description.zh: 在四四南村的眷村老屋前看見台北 101，爬上象山回頭再看一次，晚上到饒河街吃胡椒餅。
description.en: See Taipei 101 rise behind the old military village, look back at it from Elephant Mountain, then pepper buns at Raohe.

name.zh: 淡水：紅毛城走到夕陽
name.en: Tamsui: From the Fort to the Sunset

description.zh: 紅毛城的紅磚、小白宮的拱廊、馬偕的老教堂，沿著河岸一路走到漁人碼頭看夕陽。
description.en: Fort San Domingo's red brick, the Little White House and Mackay's old church, then along the river to the sunset at the wharf.

name.zh: 老咖啡館與書店的一天
name.en: A Day of Old Cafés and Bookshops

description.zh: 在半世紀的咖啡館點一杯，翻翻舊書店的老雜誌，再到紀州庵的日式老屋坐一個下午。
description.en: Order a cup in a fifty-year-old café, browse old magazines in secondhand shops and spend the afternoon at Kishu An.

name.zh: 通勤集章：捷運轉乘大站
name.en: Commuter Stamps: Big MRT Interchanges

description.zh: 上下班本來就會經過的八個轉乘大站，出站前順手蓋一枚，通勤也能集滿一條路線。
description.en: Eight interchange stations you pass anyway on the commute: tap a stamp on the way out and finish a route without trying.

name.zh: 總統府走到自由廣場
name.en: From the Presidential Office to Liberty Square

description.zh: 從總統府前的凱達格蘭大道出發，穿過二二八公園和臺博館，走到自由廣場的白色牌樓下。
description.en: Start on the boulevard before the Presidential Office, cross 228 Park and the museum, and end under Liberty Square's white gate.

name.zh: 師大永康：小籠包與日式老宅
name.en: Shida and Yongkang: Dumplings and Old Houses

description.zh: 在師大逛夜市、在青田七六的日式老宅喝杯茶，吃一籠小籠包，最後到大安森林公園躺一下。
description.en: Shida's night market, tea in a Japanese-era house at Qingtian 76, a basket of soup dumplings and a rest in Da'an Park.

name.zh: 士林：看星星，再吃夜市
name.en: Shilin: Stargazing, Then the Night Market

description.zh: 白天在天文館看星空、在科教館玩實驗，傍晚逛官邸的玫瑰園，晚上吃士林夜市。
description.en: Stars at the planetarium and experiments at the science centre by day, the residence's rose garden at dusk, then Shilin Night Market.

name.zh: 大龍峒：孔廟、保安宮與圓山
name.en: Dalongdong: Two Temples and the Grand Hotel

description.zh: 孔廟的安靜和保安宮的熱鬧只隔一條街，再走到花博公園，抬頭看圓山大飯店的紅柱子。
description.en: The quiet Confucius Temple and lively Bao'an Temple sit a street apart; walk on to Expo Park and the Grand Hotel's red columns.

name.zh: 動物園，再搭纜車上山喝茶
name.en: The Zoo, Then the Gondola Up for Tea

description.zh: 上午去動物園看貓熊，下午搭纜車晃上貓空，在山上的茶館喝一壺鐵觀音看臺北。
description.en: Pandas at the zoo in the morning, then the gondola up to Maokong for a pot of Tieguanyin and a view of the city.

name.zh: 碧潭吊橋一路到烏來瀑布
name.en: From Bitan Bridge to Wulai Falls

description.zh: 從碧潭吊橋出發，一路往山裡走，在烏來老街吃山豬肉，搭台車到瀑布前。
description.en: Start at the Bitan suspension bridge, head into the mountains, eat wild-boar sausage on Wulai Old Street and ride the cart to the falls.

name.zh: 北海岸：女王頭與最北的燈塔
name.en: North Coast: The Queen's Head and the Northern Tip

description.zh: 在野柳看女王頭，到最北端的富貴角吹海風，回程在金山老街吃一碗鴨肉。
description.en: See the Queen's Head at Yehliu, feel the wind at Fuguijiao on the northern tip, and have duck in Jinshan on the way back.

name.zh: 日常的臺北：公園、市場與圖書館
name.en: Everyday Taipei: Parks, Markets and Libraries

description.zh: 不是觀光景點，是臺北人平常會去的地方：公園、市場、書店和圖書館，週末散步順手蓋。
description.en: Not sights, just the places Taipei people actually use: parks, a market, a bookshop and a library to stamp on a weekend stroll.

name.zh: 板橋：林家花園與湳雅夜市
name.en: Banqiao: The Lin Garden and Nanya Night Market

description.zh: 林家花園的亭臺樓閣像走進古裝劇，再到新圖書館和市民廣場，晚上逛湳雅夜市。
description.en: The Lin Family Garden's pavilions feel like a period drama; then the new library, the city square and Nanya Night Market.

name.zh: 鶯歌陶瓷與三峽老街
name.en: Yingge Ceramics and Sanxia Old Street

description.zh: 在鶯歌陶瓷老街捏一個杯子，看新北市美術館，再到三峽祖師廟看一刀一刀刻出來的石柱。
description.en: Throw a cup on Yingge's ceramics street, visit the new art museum, then see the hand-carved pillars of Sanxia's Zushi Temple.

name.zh: 九份山城、黃金與十分天燈
name.en: Jiufen, Gold Mines and Shifen Lanterns

description.zh: 九份的階梯和紅燈籠、金瓜石的大金磚、陰陽海的兩色海水，回程到十分放一盞天燈。
description.en: Jiufen's steps and red lanterns, the giant gold bar at Jinguashi, the two-toned sea, and a sky lantern at Shifen.

name.zh: 新莊廟街到永和豆漿
name.en: Xinzhuang Temple Street to Yonghe Soy Milk

description.zh: 新莊的廟街小吃、大學校園和河濱大公園，晚上上烘爐地看夜景，最後一碗永和豆漿。
description.en: Temple-street snacks in Xinzhuang, a campus and a riverside park, the night view from Hongludi and a bowl of Yonghe soy milk.

name.zh: 南港內湖：音樂、展覽與摩天輪
name.en: Nangang and Neihu: Music, Expos and a Ferris Wheel

description.zh: 胡適住過的老宅、流行音樂中心的新建築，傍晚到碧湖散步，再搭摩天輪看內湖的燈。
description.en: Hu Shih's old home, the new pop music centre, an evening walk around Bihu Lake and the Ferris wheel over Neihu.

name.zh: 演唱會、球賽與出發的地方
name.en: Concerts, Ball Games and Departures

description.zh: 小巨蛋、大巨蛋、北藝中心和松山機場，看演唱會、球賽或出國前都能順手蓋一枚。
description.en: The two domes, the performing arts centre and Songshan Airport: collect a stamp before a concert, a game or a flight.

name.zh: 臺中舊城：綠川與宮原眼科
name.en: Old Taichung: Lüchuan and Miyahara

description.zh: 出了臺中車站先看百年紅磚舊站，沿綠川走到宮原眼科吃冰淇淋，再看日治時期的州廳。
description.en: Step out of Taichung Station to the century-old brick one, follow Lüchuan to ice cream at Miyahara and the old prefecture hall.

name.zh: 臺中公園、老屋與第一杯珍奶
name.en: Taichung Park, Old Houses and the First Bubble Tea

description.zh: 臺中公園的湖心亭、老酒廠、刑務所演武場，再到春水堂喝一杯據說最早的珍珠奶茶。
description.en: The lake pavilion, an old winery, the prison's martial-arts hall, and bubble tea where it is said to have begun.

name.zh: 草悟道：美術館到審計新村
name.en: Calligraphy Greenway: Art Museum to Shenji Village

description.zh: 沿著草悟道的綠蔭走，看國美館、科博館的恐龍，逛審計新村的小店，晚上到一中街。
description.en: Walk the shady greenway past the art museum and dinosaurs, shop the little stores of Shenji Village and end on Yizhong Street.

name.zh: 臺中新地標：歌劇院與綠美圖
name.en: Taichung's New Landmarks: The Opera and the Green Library

description.zh: 伊東豊雄設計的歌劇院、秋紅谷的湖，再到水湳的綠美圖，晚上逛逢甲夜市。
description.en: Toyo Ito's opera house, the lake at Calligraphy Park, the new green library in Shuinan and Fengjia Night Market at night.

name.zh: 鹽埕駁二：港邊倉庫與大港橋
name.en: Yancheng and Pier-2: Warehouses and the Swing Bridge

description.zh: 從美麗島站的光之穹頂出發，沿愛河走到駁二倉庫，等大港橋轉開，再看流行音樂中心的燈。
description.en: Start under the Dome of Light, follow the Love River to the Pier-2 warehouses, watch the bridge swing and see the music centre lit up.

name.zh: 南屯老街到霧峰林家
name.en: Nantun Old Street to the Lin Mansion

description.zh: 萬和宮前的南屯老街、霧峰林家的大宅院，再到九二一地震園區看斷掉的操場。
description.en: Nantun Old Street before Wanhe Temple, the Lin family mansion in Wufeng and the broken running track at the 921 museum.

name.zh: 路思義教堂到高美濕地夕陽
name.en: Luce Chapel to Sunset at Gaomei

description.zh: 東海大學的路思義教堂、彩虹眷村的彩繪，傍晚到高美濕地踩著水看風車和夕陽。
description.en: Tunghai's Luce Chapel and the painted Rainbow Village, then wade out at Gaomei to watch the turbines and the sunset.

name.zh: 豐原后里：騎鐵馬、吃糖廠冰
name.en: Fengyuan and Houli: Bike Paths and Sugar-Mill Ice

description.zh: 在廟東吃排骨酥，騎上舊鐵道改成的自行車綠廊，到月眉糖廠吃一支冰，再去麗寶樂園。
description.en: Pork rib soup by Ciji Temple, a bike ride on an old rail line, an ice pop at Yuemei Sugar Factory and then Lihpao Land.

name.zh: 哈瑪星搭渡輪到旗津
name.en: Hamasen and the Ferry to Cijin

description.zh: 哈瑪星的鐵道館、山坡上的英國領事館，搭五分鐘渡輪到旗津，爬上燈塔看港口。
description.en: Hamasen's railway museum, the British consulate on the hill, a five-minute ferry to Cijin and the lighthouse above the harbour.

name.zh: 高雄郊外：佛陀、糖廠與月世界
name.en: Out of Kaohsiung: Buddha, Sugar and Moon World

description.zh: 佛陀紀念館的大佛、橋頭糖廠的老煙囪、旗山的香蕉老街，最後到月世界看泥岩山。
description.en: The great Buddha, the old chimneys at Qiaotou sugar mill, Qishan's banana street and the bare mudstone hills of Moon World.

name.zh: 蓮池潭：龍虎塔與舊城門
name.en: Lotus Pond: Dragon and Tiger Pagodas

description.zh: 走進龍虎塔的龍口、從虎口出來，沿蓮池潭看舊城門，晚上到瑞豐夜市。
description.en: In through the dragon's mouth and out the tiger's at the pagodas, along Lotus Pond to the old city gate, then Ruifeng Night Market.

name.zh: 高雄車站周邊：廟街與老站
name.en: Around Kaohsiung Station: Temple Street and the Old Station

description.zh: 三鳳宮前的年貨大街、百年三塊厝車站和蒸汽火車頭，再吃一碗港園牛肉麵。
description.en: The New Year market street at Sanfeng Temple, a century-old station with its steam engine and a bowl of beef noodles.

name.zh: 高雄港灣：圖書館到夢時代
name.en: Kaohsiung Harbour: Library to Dream Mall

description.zh: 新堀江逛街、中央公園散步，在港邊的圖書館總館看海，再到夢時代搭摩天輪。
description.en: Shop in Xinkujiang, walk Central Park, read with a sea view at the main library and ride the wheel at Dream Mall.

name.zh: 鳳山：衛武營的大屋頂
name.en: Fengshan: Under Weiwuying's Great Roof

description.zh: 衛武營像一片大樹冠的屋頂下散步，看鳳儀書院和龍山寺，最後到澄清湖的九曲橋。
description.en: Walk under Weiwuying's great canopy roof, see the old academy and Longshan Temple, and finish on Chengcing Lake's zigzag bridge.

name.zh: 府城中西區：孔廟、武廟與林百貨
name.en: Central Tainan: Temples and Hayashi

description.zh: 孔廟、武廟、大天后宮都在幾條街內，再到林百貨搭老電梯上屋頂，半天走完府城的老中心。
description.en: The Confucius, Martial and Matsu temples within a few streets, then the old lift up to Hayashi's rooftop: old Tainan in half a day.

name.zh: 府城小吃與老巷
name.en: Tainan's Snacks and Lanes

description.zh: 神農街的老屋、水仙宮市場的魚丸湯、度小月的擔仔麵，晚上再挑一個夜市繼續吃。
description.en: Old houses on Shennong Street, fish-ball soup at Shuixian market, danzai noodles, then pick a night market to keep going.

name.zh: 新竹：老車站、城隍廟與東門城
name.en: Hsinchu: Old Station, City God and East Gate

description.zh: 新竹車站的巴洛克老站房、城隍廟口的貢丸米粉，再到東門城和新竹公園散步。
description.en: The baroque old station, meatball soup by the City God Temple, then the East Gate and a walk in Hsinchu Park.

name.zh: 新竹海港與客家老街
name.en: Hsinchu's Harbour and Hakka Old Streets

description.zh: 南寮漁港看海、香山濕地看招潮蟹，再到北埔和內灣吃客家粄條、擂茶。
description.en: Sea views at Nanliao, fiddler crabs at Xiangshan, then Hakka noodles and pounded tea in Beipu and Neiwan.

name.zh: 大溪老街與慈湖
name.en: Daxi Old Street and Cihu

description.zh: 大溪老街的巴洛克牌樓和木器行，再到慈湖看滿園的銅像，往山裡去石門水庫。
description.en: Daxi's baroque arcades and woodcraft shops, the field of statues at Cihu, then up to the Shimen Reservoir.

name.zh: 桃園：機場、水族館與漁港
name.en: Taoyuan: Airport, Aquarium and Harbours

description.zh: 出國前後順路：機場、高鐵站旁的水族館、新圖書館和兩座漁港，小人國也在路線上。
description.en: Easy before or after a flight: the airport, the aquarium by the HSR station, the new library, two harbours and Window on China.

name.zh: 安平：古堡、樹屋與綠色隧道
name.en: Anping: Forts, the Tree House and a Mangrove Tunnel

description.zh: 安平古堡的四百年城牆、被榕樹吞掉的樹屋，再搭竹筏穿過四草的綠色隧道。
description.en: Four-hundred-year-old fort walls, a warehouse swallowed by banyans, and a raft through the mangrove tunnel at Sicao.

name.zh: 成大、開元寺到奇美博物館
name.en: NCKU, Kaiyuan Temple and the Chimei Museum

description.zh: 從臺南車站走進成大的榕園，到開元寺和臺南公園，再往南去奇美博物館的白色宮殿。
description.en: From Tainan Station into NCKU's banyan garden, on to Kaiyuan Temple and the park, then south to Chimei's white palace.

name.zh: 鹽山與瓦盤鹽田
name.en: Salt Mountain and Tile-Bed Salt Fields

description.zh: 爬上白色的七股鹽山，看井仔腳瓦盤鹽田的夕陽倒影，再到南鯤鯓代天府。
description.en: Climb the white salt mountain at Qigu, watch the sunset on Jingzaijiao's tiled salt pans and visit Nankunshen Temple.

name.zh: 臺南溪北：老街、糖廠與水庫
name.en: Northern Tainan: Old Streets, Sugar and a Reservoir

description.zh: 新化老街的巴洛克立面、糖廠改成的鼓樂園區，再到烏山頭水庫和菁寮的老街。
description.en: Xinhua's baroque façades, a sugar mill turned drum park, the Wushantou Reservoir and Jingliao's old street.

name.zh: 花東縱谷：林場、糖廠與牧場
name.en: Rift Valley: Forestry Village, Sugar Mill and Ranch

description.zh: 林田山的檜木宿舍、光復糖廠的冰、瑞穗牧場的鮮奶，沿著縱谷一路往南。
description.en: Cypress houses at Lintianshan, ice at the Guangfu sugar mill and fresh milk at Ruisui, heading south down the valley.

name.zh: 花蓮市區：松園、將軍府與夜市
name.en: Hualien City: Pine Garden, Old Residences and a Night Market

description.zh: 松園別館的老松、將軍府的日式宿舍、文創園區的酒廠倉庫，晚上吃東大門夜市。
description.en: The old pines at Pine Garden, Japanese-era residences, the winery warehouses of the creative park and Dongdamen at night.

name.zh: 七星潭、太魯閣與鯉魚潭
name.en: Qixingtan, Taroko and Liyu Lake

description.zh: 七星潭的礫石海灘聽浪、太魯閣的峽谷，再到鯉魚潭划船，海洋公園也在路線上。
description.en: Listen to the pebble beach at Qixingtan, see Taroko's gorge, paddle on Liyu Lake and visit the ocean park.

name.zh: 宜蘭市與礁溪：泡腳、看幾米
name.en: Yilan and Jiaoxi: Foot Baths and Jimmy Liao

description.zh: 宜蘭車站前的幾米公園、老酒廠，再到礁溪泡腳，最後走一段頭城老街。
description.en: Jimmy Liao's park by Yilan Station and the old winery, a foot soak in Jiaoxi and a stroll down Toucheng Old Street.

name.zh: 羅東夜市、傳藝中心與冷泉
name.en: Luodong Night Market, Arts Centre and Cold Springs

description.zh: 羅東林場的貯木池、傳藝中心的老街，晚上逛羅東夜市，隔天到蘇澳泡冷泉。
description.en: The log ponds at Luodong, the traditional arts centre, Luodong Night Market, and a cold-spring soak in Su'ao.

name.zh: 宜蘭山海：太平山到威士忌
name.en: Yilan: Taipingshan to the Whisky Distillery

description.zh: 從海邊像單面山的蘭陽博物館，到五峰旗瀑布、噶瑪蘭酒廠，再上太平山的檜木林。
description.en: From the Lanyang Museum, shaped like a cuesta by the sea, to Wufengqi Falls, the Kavalan distillery and Taipingshan's cypress forest.

name.zh: 嘉義：火雞肉飯與舊監獄
name.en: Chiayi: Turkey Rice and the Old Prison

description.zh: 一碗噴水火雞肉飯開場，看日治時期的舊監獄和美術館，晚上逛文化路夜市。
description.en: Start with Penshui's turkey rice, tour the Japanese-era prison and the art museum, then Wenhua Road Night Market.

name.zh: 搭森林鐵路上阿里山
name.en: Up to Alishan on the Forest Railway

description.zh: 從北門車站和檜木老屋出發，搭森林鐵路上奮起湖吃便當，終點是阿里山的神木。
description.en: From Beimen Station and the cypress houses, ride the forest railway to a lunchbox at Fenqihu and the giant trees of Alishan.

name.zh: 故宮南院、新港與東石海邊
name.en: Southern Palace Museum, Xingang and the Sea

description.zh: 故宮南院的亞洲文物、新港奉天宮、板陶窯的交趾陶，最後到東石漁人碼頭看海。
description.en: Asian treasures at the Southern Palace Museum, Fengtian Temple, koji pottery at Bantaoyao and the sea at Dongshi.

name.zh: 山手線一圈，一站一章
name.en: Round the Yamanote Line, a Stamp at Each Stop

description.zh: 山手線一圈的十個大站，每站出閘口走一小段，從秋葉原的電器街到原宿的新站房，一站蓋一枚。
description.en: Ten big stations around the Yamanote loop: step out at each, from Akihabara's electric town to Harajuku's new station, and collect a stamp.

name.zh: 澀谷十字路口到新宿橫丁
name.en: Shibuya Crossing to Shinjuku's Alleys

description.zh: 站在澀谷十字路口的人潮裡、上 SHIBUYA SKY 看夕陽，走過明治神宮，晚上鑽進新宿的回憶橫丁。
description.en: Stand in the Shibuya scramble, watch sunset from Shibuya Sky, walk through Meiji Jingu and squeeze into Omoide Yokocho at night.

name.zh: 上野博物館與谷中老街
name.en: Ueno's Museums and Yanaka's Old Streets

description.zh: 上野公園裡三座博物館和動物園，逛阿美橫町，再走進谷中銀座的老商店街和根津神社的鳥居。
description.en: Three museums and a zoo in Ueno Park, a stroll through Ameyoko, then old shops in Yanaka Ginza and the torii of Nezu Shrine.

name.zh: 嵐山：渡月橋、竹林與小火車
name.en: Arashiyama: Bridge, Bamboo and the Scenic Train

description.zh: 搭嵐電到嵐山，走過渡月橋和天龍寺，穿過竹林小徑，再搭小火車沿保津川峽谷。
description.en: Take the Randen tram to Arashiyama, cross Togetsukyō, visit Tenryū-ji, walk the bamboo grove and ride the scenic train along the gorge.

name.zh: 晴空塔、東京鐵塔與老江戶
name.en: Skytree, Tokyo Tower and Old Edo

description.zh: 淺草寺的雷門、晴空塔和東京鐵塔，加上兩國國技館和日本橋，看新舊東京疊在一起。
description.en: Sensō-ji's Thunder Gate, Skytree and Tokyo Tower, plus sumo at Ryōgoku and Nihonbashi: old and new Tokyo layered together.

name.zh: 神保町書街到豐洲
name.en: Jimbōchō's Bookshops to Toyosu

description.zh: 在神保町翻舊書、代官山蔦屋喝咖啡，再到豐洲市場吃海鮮丼、teamLab 走進光影裡。
description.en: Old books in Jimbōchō, coffee at Daikanyama Tsutaya, a seafood bowl at Toyosu and a walk into the light at teamLab.

name.zh: 吉祥寺：井之頭公園與吉卜力
name.en: Kichijōji: Inokashira Park and Ghibli

description.zh: 井之頭公園划天鵝船、三鷹的吉卜力美術館，再到豪德寺看滿坑滿谷的招財貓。
description.en: Swan boats in Inokashira Park, the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka and the hundreds of beckoning cats at Gōtoku-ji.

name.zh: 東京的起點與終點：機場與迪士尼
name.en: Tokyo's Gateways: Airports and Disneyland

description.zh: 羽田、成田兩座機場和東京迪士尼，抵達、離開和最開心的那一天都能蓋一枚。
description.en: Haneda, Narita and Tokyo Disneyland: a stamp for the day you arrive, the day you leave and the happiest day in between.

name.zh: 虎尾布袋戲與北港媽祖
name.en: Huwei Puppetry and Beigang's Matsu Temple

description.zh: 在虎尾看布袋戲、聞糖廠的甜味，到北港朝天宮拜媽祖，再去成龍濕地看裝置藝術。
description.en: Glove puppets and the sweet smell of the sugar mill in Huwei, Matsu at Beigang's Chaotian Temple and art at Chenglong Wetlands.

name.zh: 西螺大橋、醬油與斗六老街
name.en: Xiluo Bridge, Soy Sauce and Douliu Old Street

description.zh: 走過紅色的西螺大橋，在延平老街聞醬油香，再到斗六的巴洛克老街和日式宿舍。
description.en: Cross the red Xiluo Bridge, follow the smell of soy sauce down Yanping Street, then Douliu's baroque arcades and old houses.

name.zh: 糖廠巡禮：一路吃冰到花蓮
name.en: Sugar Mill Trail: Ice Pops from Taichung to Hualien

description.zh: 從臺中月眉到花蓮光復，十座老糖廠各有煙囪、五分車和一支冰棒，吃完一路就集滿了。
description.en: From Yuemei to Guangfu, ten old sugar mills, each with a chimney, a cane train and an ice pop to finish the route.

name.zh: 清水寺走到祇園
name.en: From Kiyomizu-dera to Gion

description.zh: 清水寺的舞台、二年坂三年坂的石板路、八坂神社，一路走到祇園的花見小路和先斗町。
description.en: Kiyomizu-dera's stage, the stone lanes of Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka, Yasaka Shrine, then Gion's Hanamikoji and Pontochō.

name.zh: 金閣寺、龍安寺與京都御所
name.en: Kinkaku-ji, Ryōan-ji and the Imperial Palace

description.zh: 金閣寺映在池裡、龍安寺的石庭、二條城的鶯聲地板，再到御所和下鴨神社的森林。
description.en: Kinkaku-ji reflected in its pond, Ryōan-ji's rock garden, Nijō Castle's nightingale floors, the Imperial Palace and Shimogamo's forest.

name.zh: 哲學之道：銀閣寺走到南禪寺
name.en: Philosopher's Path: Ginkaku-ji to Nanzen-ji

description.zh: 從銀閣寺沿著水渠走，春天是櫻花、秋天是紅葉，走到南禪寺的水路閣，再到平安神宮的大鳥居。
description.en: Follow the canal from Ginkaku-ji under cherry blossom or autumn leaves to Nanzen-ji's aqueduct and Heian Shrine's great torii.

name.zh: 伏見稻荷到宇治抹茶
name.en: Fushimi Inari to Matcha in Uji

description.zh: 京都塔、東寺的五重塔、鐵道博物館的蒸汽火車，穿過伏見稻荷的千本鳥居，最後到宇治喝抹茶。
description.en: Kyoto Tower, Tō-ji's pagoda, steam engines at the railway museum, Fushimi Inari's torii and matcha in Uji.

name.zh: 奈良：鹿、大佛與春日大社
name.en: Nara: Deer, the Great Buddha and Kasuga

description.zh: 在奈良公園被鹿鞠躬，看東大寺的大佛和春日大社的石燈籠，再到法隆寺看最古老的木造建築。
description.en: Get bowed to by deer in Nara Park, see the Great Buddha and Kasuga's stone lanterns, then the world's oldest wooden buildings at Hōryū-ji.

name.zh: 道頓堀到通天閣
name.en: Dōtonbori to Tsūtenkaku

description.zh: 在道頓堀的固力果跑跑人前拍照，逛心齋橋和黑門市場，到新世界吃串炸、登通天閣。
description.en: Pose in front of the Glico runner at Dōtonbori, shop Shinsaibashi and Kuromon, then kushikatsu and Tsūtenkaku in Shinsekai.

name.zh: 梅田空中庭園與大阪城
name.en: Umeda Sky Building and Osaka Castle

description.zh: 梅田空中庭園的環形展望台、日本最長的天神橋筋商店街，再到中之島和大阪城。
description.en: The ring-shaped deck at the Umeda Sky Building, Japan's longest shopping street at Tenjinbashi, then Nakanoshima and Osaka Castle.

name.zh: 環球影城、海遊館與太陽之塔
name.en: Universal Studios, Kaiyukan and the Tower of the Sun

description.zh: 環球影城玩一整天、海遊館看鯨鯊，再到萬博公園抬頭看太陽之塔的三張臉。
description.en: A full day at Universal Studios, whale sharks at Kaiyukan and the three faces of the Tower of the Sun in Expo Park.

name.zh: 神戶港與白鷺城
name.en: Kobe Harbour and Himeji Castle

description.zh: 北野異人館的洋房、南京町的小籠包、紅色的神戶港塔，再搭電車到姬路看白鷺城。
description.en: Western houses in Kitano, dumplings in Nankinmachi and the red Port Tower, then the train to Himeji's white castle.

name.zh: 博多：屋台與一蘭總本店
name.en: Hakata: Yatai Stalls and Ichiran's Main Shop

description.zh: 博多站、櫛田神社和運河城，晚上在中洲的屋台吃拉麵關東煮，再去一蘭總本店。
description.en: Hakata Station, Kushida Shrine and Canal City, then ramen and oden at the Nakasu yatai and Ichiran's main shop.

name.zh: 大濠公園到福岡塔
name.en: Ōhori Park to Fukuoka Tower

description.zh: 福岡城跡的石垣、大濠公園的湖，再到百道濱海邊看福岡塔和巨蛋。
description.en: The stone walls of Fukuoka Castle, the lake at Ōhori Park, then the beach at Momochi with Fukuoka Tower and the dome.

name.zh: 太宰府、柳川遊船與門司港
name.en: Dazaifu, Yanagawa Boats and Mojikō

description.zh: 太宰府吃梅枝餅、柳川坐小船穿過水道，再到門司港的懷舊街區和糸島的夫婦岩。
description.en: Plum cakes at Dazaifu, a punt through Yanagawa's canals, Mojikō's retro harbour and the wedded rocks of Itoshima.

name.zh: 函館：朝市、紅磚倉庫與百萬夜景
name.en: Hakodate: Morning Market, Red Bricks and the Night View

description.zh: 函館朝市的海鮮丼、金森紅磚倉庫、八幡坂看海，從五稜郭塔看星形城郭，晚上搭纜車看夜景。
description.en: A seafood bowl at the morning market, the red-brick warehouses, the sea from Hachiman-zaka, the star fort and the night view.

name.zh: 富良野薰衣草與美瑛青池
name.en: Furano Lavender and Biei's Blue Pond

description.zh: 富田農場的紫色薰衣草、森林精靈露台的小木屋，美瑛白金青池的藍，再到旭山動物園看企鵝。
description.en: Purple lavender at Farm Tomita, the cabins of Ningle Terrace, the blue of Shirogane pond and penguins at Asahiyama Zoo.

name.zh: 那霸：國際通與市場
name.en: Naha: Kokusai-dōri and the Market

description.zh: 國際通的商店街、牧志市場樓上現煮海鮮，壺屋陶器街和海邊懸崖上的波上宮。
description.en: The shops of Kokusai-dōri, seafood cooked upstairs at Makishi market, Tsuboya's pottery street and Naminoue Shrine on its cliff.

name.zh: 琉球王國：首里城與聖地
name.en: The Ryūkyū Kingdom: Shuri Castle and Sacred Sites

description.zh: 首里城、王族的陵墓玉陵、聖地齋場御嶽，再到中城和今歸仁的城跡看琉球王國的過去。
description.en: Shuri Castle, the royal tombs of Tamaudun, the sacred site of Sēfa-utaki and the castle ruins of Nakagusuku and Nakijin.

name.zh: 沖繩海岸：古宇利大橋到美麗海
name.en: Okinawa's Coast: Kōri Bridge to Churaumi

description.zh: 美國村的摩天輪、真榮田岬的藍洞、萬座毛的象鼻岩，開過古宇利大橋，最後到美麗海水族館。
description.en: American Village, the blue waters of Cape Maeda, Manzamo's elephant rock, the drive over Kōri Bridge and Churaumi.

name.zh: 金澤兼六園，再到白川鄉
name.en: Kanazawa's Kenroku-en, Then Shirakawa-gō

description.zh: 兼六園的雪吊松、21世紀美術館的游泳池、近江町市場的海鮮，再搭巴士到白川鄉的合掌村。
description.en: Kenroku-en's roped pines, the swimming pool at the 21st Century Museum, Ōmichō's seafood and a bus to Shirakawa-gō's farmhouses.

name.zh: 札幌：大通公園到薄野
name.en: Sapporo: Ōdōri Park to Susukino

description.zh: 從北海道大學走到紅磚的舊道廳和時計台，大通公園上電視塔，晚上到薄野吃味噌拉麵。
description.en: From Hokkaido University to the red-brick government hall and clock tower, up the TV Tower, then miso ramen in Susukino.

name.zh: 白色戀人、啤酒與藻岩山夜景
name.en: Shiroi Koibito, Beer and the Night View from Moiwa

description.zh: 白色戀人的工廠、札幌啤酒的紅磚館、大倉山跳台，晚上搭纜車上藻岩山看夜景。
description.en: The Shiroi Koibito factory, the red-brick beer museum, the Ōkurayama ski jump and the night view from Mt Moiwa.

name.zh: 小樽運河、玻璃與音樂盒
name.en: Otaru: Canal, Glass and Music Boxes

description.zh: 從小樽老車站出發，沿運河看石造倉庫，在堺町通看玻璃和音樂盒，蒸汽鐘整點會響。
description.en: From Otaru's old station along the canal's stone warehouses to Sakaimachi's glass and music boxes, where the steam clock sings on the hour.

name.zh: 名古屋城與大須商店街
name.en: Nagoya Castle and Ōsu Shopping Street

description.zh: 名古屋城的金鯱、大須商店街的小吃、熱田神宮的森林，再到豐田紀念館看織布機變成汽車。
description.en: Nagoya Castle's golden fish, snacks on Ōsu shopping street, Atsuta's forest and the Toyota museum, from looms to cars.

name.zh: 吉卜力公園、樂高樂園與犬山城
name.en: Ghibli Park, Legoland and Inuyama Castle

description.zh: 吉卜力公園走進動畫場景、樂高樂園、名古屋港水族館，再到犬山城登上最古老的天守。
description.en: Step into anime scenes at Ghibli Park, then Legoland, the port aquarium and one of Japan's oldest castle keeps at Inuyama.

name.zh: 廣島：和平公園與御好燒
name.en: Hiroshima: Peace Park and Okonomiyaki

description.zh: 原爆圓頂館與和平紀念公園，再到廣島城和縮景園，晚上吃一份層層疊起的廣島御好燒。
description.en: The A-Bomb Dome and Peace Park, Hiroshima Castle and Shukkei-en, then a layered Hiroshima okonomiyaki.

name.zh: 宮島海上鳥居與瀨戶內
name.en: Miyajima's Floating Torii and the Inland Sea

description.zh: 搭渡輪到宮島看海上大鳥居，搭纜車上彌山，再到吳的大和博物館和尾道的千光寺。
description.en: The ferry to Miyajima's floating torii, the ropeway up Mt Misen, then the Yamato Museum in Kure and Senkō-ji in Onomichi.
